definitions.name: U2A.DELTAS
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'BC' BIND 1 -1 '([' BC SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 per opening and -1 per closing bracket

definitions.name: U2A.REDUCE
definitions.body: 'RS' BIND 1 8 RANGE RS [ 'RE' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String (up to 16 chars) -> what is left after repeatedly deleting adjacent () and [] pairs

definitions.name: U2A.MISSMASK
definitions.note: Vector with NIL lanes -> same-length Vector of 1 where missing, 0 where present

definitions.name: U2A.LINEREV
definitions.body: 'LR' BIND LR 'price' GET 'LP' BIND 0 LP LP NIL? SELECT LR 'qty' GET MUL
definitions.note: order Record -> qty times price, or 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: U2A.REVENUE
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total of qty times price over priced orders

definitions.name: U2A.QTYBYSKU

definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record sku -> summed qty, skus in first-appearance order
